description: This stacked bar chart illustrates the distribution of hateful communication datasets across different target categories over a ten-year period from 2012 to 2022, with each bar representing one year and its height normalized to a maximum value of 1.0 on the vertical axis, which is labeled “Target” and scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0. The horizontal axis is labeled “Year” and displays the years in chronological order from left to right. Each bar is segmented into five colored portions, corresponding to the target category distribution as defined in the legend: blue for targets of 0, orange for targets of 1, green for targets of 2–4, red for targets of 5–7, and purple for targets of 8+. The approximate values for each segment across the years are as follows: in 2012, the bar is entirely green (value ≈1.0); in 2013, it is entirely blue (value ≈1.0); in 2014, it is composed of blue (≈0.5), orange (≈0.5), with no other segments; in 2015, it is blue (≈0.5) and green (≈0.5); in 2016, it is blue (≈0.2), orange (≈0.6), and green (≈0.2); in 2017, it is blue (≈0.5), orange (≈0.2), green (≈0.3); in 2018, it is blue (≈0.4), orange (≈0.2), green (≈0.4); in 2019, it is blue (≈0.2), orange (≈0.2), green (≈0.4), red (≈0.2); in 2020, it is blue (≈0.4), orange (≈0.2), green (≈0.4); in 2021, it is blue (≈0.4), orange (≈0.2), green (≈0.4); and in 2022, it is blue (≈0.3), orange (≈0.3), green (≈0.2), red (≈0.2). The bars are not sorted and are presented in chronological order, with no visual emphasis applied to any particular bar or segment.
